QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_41

question.text: Under SAS-500, 'forest conservation' outcome indicators should be MEASURED using:

answer.text: Appropriate SIA data tools such as satellite imagery for forestry coverage plus desk review, physical inspection, stakeholder interviews, and baseline/midline/endline metrics

explanation.text: The Logic: SAS-500 supports the use of satellite imagery for forestry coverage along with standard IWMP metrics such as green cover, biodiversity, soil/water quality, plus physical inspection — combining multiple SIA data tools to triangulate outcomes. The Trap: Options B, C and D are single-source or irrelevant and would not satisfy SAS-500 evidence expectations. Note: Combine the SIA data tools — satellite imagery, desk review, physical inspection, stakeholder interviews, and baseline/midline/endline measurements — to build defensible outcome evidence.
